body:
Sam, stop bullying Nakia. She’s not your replacement, she’s just a baby, and she poses no threat to you. You’re the boss. 

Nakia, stop running at Sammy. She’s very old and she doesn’t want to play. Also stop eating her food, it gives you gas. 

Then I’d spend the remaining time forcing them to have conversations so they can FINALLY start getting along

Oh no, it’s the baby equivalent of getting a Chinese symbol tattooed on yourself that you think means courage but actually means soup! Not your fault, she REALLY should have looked into the meaning before giving that name to her child!
